annotations.title: Check a design value against a datasheet's rules

description: Check one design value against every rule DatasheetVend extracted from a datasheet (its pin-cautions rulebook): for example a 4.7 kΩ pull-up, a 100 nF decoupling capacitor or a 3.6 V supply. Returns pass, fail or needs_review per rule that applies, with the rule's datasheet source, and a summary that counts EVERY rule, including the ones that could not be compared, so 0 failures never hides 'nothing was compared'. An unknown unit is refused, not passed. Pass the job_id of an extraction in your account that ran the pin_cautions module. Deterministic: runs DatasheetVend's checks in code, calls no model and extracts nothing. Costs no credits. Needs a DatasheetVend API key.

job_id.description: An extraction job in your account that ran the pin_cautions module.

package.description: The package the design uses (for example 'TQFP32'), so package-specific rules apply.

unit.description: Its unit, for example 'kohm', 'nF', 'V', 'mA'. An unrecognised unit is refused.

value.description: The design value to check, for example 4.7

name: datasheetvend_check_design_value
